sentence: With spandex in a clothing blend, read the care label instead of assuming every stretchy garment tolerates the same packing pressure.
en_before: To roll a T-shirt, first fold it into a rectangle with sleeves contained. Roll evenly from one end with moderate tension to avoid twisting, without squeezing as though wringing laundry. Align soft pant legs first, then roll upward from the hems. If the waistband is too thick, flat folding may pack more easily.
en_after: To roll a T-shirt, first fold it into a rectangle with sleeves contained.
